claim: The number of attempts is declared before the first one runs, every attempt is retained, and a conclusion drawn from fewer than the declared number is refused.

steps.label: five declared, five run, all agreeing
four greens and a temptation to stop
steps.note: Run it again because that one looked odd; stop when it is green. Every step is reasonable, and the series measures the stopping rule rather than the system.

steps.label: five run, one disagreed
steps.evidence: an unstable series has no outcome
steps.note: Reporting the majority would turn 'fails one time in five' into 'passes', which is the whole failure this app prevents.

steps.label: a sixth attempt after the declared five
steps.note: Included, not trimmed. Discarding it would be the same selective stopping running backwards.

steps.label: five failures
steps.evidence: stable means the system agrees with itself, not that the news is good

steps.label: declaring a single run
steps.note: One attempt cannot disagree with anything.
